resources.string: pref_read_source
Reading data source
Arctic Shift reads archived posts newest first. Comments and counts may lag behind Reddit. Reddit and Redlib use live data. Refresh after switching.
Arctic Shift archive · newest first
pref_redlib_url
Redlib server address
Use this server for anonymous reading. Leave empty to use Reddit directly.
pref_redlib_api_key
Redlib server key
pref_fushi_tap_lookup
Tap words to look up in Fushi
Tap words in titles, posts and comments to open Fushi with full sentence context. Highlight clears when you return.
Install or enable Fushi to look up words.
Enter an HTTP or HTTPS server address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
Reddit web session Cookie
Set your own reddit_session Cookie. Stored encrypted on this device, excluded from settings backups. Never sent to Redlib or Arctic Shift.

Paste the reddit_session value or a browser Cookie header (not the whole cURL command). Only reddit_session is retained. Select Reddit web session as the reading source and use the anonymous account in RedReader. Front page uses this session home subscribed home feed. Sorting uses real Reddit routes; some may return 403. Expired sessions must be replaced manually. Refresh or reopen a list after changes.
Session saved on this device. Tap to replace or clear it. Select the web session data source and refresh. Front page reads the session home home feed.
Reddit web session - read only
Configure your Reddit web session Cookie in Settings / Network first.
Web session mode supports reading only. Use an OAuth account for write actions.
